notes: Added core story set for Clinical Trials Search feature covering contract, logic, API integration, and tests.

change_log.note: Define input/output contract for trials search

EVAL-F-001-S1.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-001-S1.description: Define Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations, travel distance/time). Ensure alignment with tool router validation.

EVAL-F-001-S2.title: Implement Clinical Trials Search Core Logic
EVAL-F-001-S2.description: Implement search against ClinicalTrials.gov API filtered to recruiting studies. Extract and normalize trial title, phase, summary, eligibility, and locations. Enrich with optional travel distance and duration using Google Routes API.

EVAL-F-001-S3.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-F-001-S3.description: Integrate clinical trials search into evaluate_care_facade. Ensure tool_router can invoke the search with validated inputs and return structured results to the chat layer.

EVAL-F-001-S4.title: Clinical Trials Search Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F-001-S4.description: Create unit tests for trial parsing, eligibility extraction, and travel enrichment. Add integration tests validating end-to-end flow from tool_router through facade to service with real or mocked API responses.
EVAL-F-001-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file; must create tests under backend/tests/ for clinical_trials_service and facade integration.
